blocks.html: Buildings and other structures located in whole or in part in flood hazard areas shall meet the requirements of Section 5.3 of ASCE 7 and Appendix G of this code. The structural design shall be based on the design loads stated in Section 5.4 of ASCE 7, the load combinations of Section 1605, and Appendix G of this code.
